(NYSE: LDI) (together with its subsidiaries, “loanDepot”), a national mortgage and home equity lender with $592B funded directly to consumers, continues to receive national recognition in 2026 for performance across several categories valued by today’s borrowers including customer satisfaction, closing speed, digital platform performance and fintech leadership.
Recognized as a Top Mortgage and Home Equity Lender by Leading Financial Media in 2026
loanDepot has been included in various “best lender” rankings for mortgage and home equity lending, including:
Best HELOC Lenders of 2026 ranking in May 2026.
Named Best for Closing Speed in
Best Mortgage Lenders of September 2026 ranking.
top 10 home lenders in its Customer Satisfaction, Home Lending rankings for the second quarter of 2026.
America’s Best Online Platforms 2026 ranking in the Banks, Investments and Loans category in June 2026.
World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026 in the Alternative Financing category in July 2026

“These honors recognize our continued commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience across both home equity and mortgage lending,” said loanDepot Chief Growth Officer Nikul Patel. “We are streamlining the mortgage and home equity lending process and developing thoughtful lending products that serve today’s market. By expanding access to the benefits of homeownership, we are helping more Americans move confidently toward their homeownership and financial goals.”

Since its launch in 2010, loanDepot (NYSE: LDI) has revolutionized the mortgage industry with digital innovations that make transacting easier, faster, and less stressful for customers and originators alike. The company, which is licensed in all 50 states, helps its customers achieve the American dream of homeownership through a broad suite of lending and real estate services that simplify one of life's most complex transactions. loanDepot is also committed to serving the communities in which its team lives and works through a variety of local and national philanthropic efforts.
